name: Doxy.me vs TheraNest
title: Doxy.me vs TheraNest: Standalone Telehealth vs Full EHR Comparison
description: Compare Doxy.me (free HIPAA telehealth) and TheraNest (mental health EHR with telehealth). Understand when to use dedicated telehealth vs an all-in-one EHR.

summary.bottom_line: Doxy.me is a standalone HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with a free tier. TheraNest is a complete mental health EHR that includes telehealth. Choose Doxy.me if you only need telehealth (or want it free); choose TheraNest if you need practice management (scheduling, billing, notes) with telehealth included.

key_differences.free_option: Doxy.me (free tier) vs TheraNest (no free tier)

sections.heading: Doxy.me vs TheraNest: Overview
sections.content: Doxy.me and TheraNest serve different scopes. Doxy.me is a focused telehealth platform—it does video visits well and offers a genuinely free HIPAA-compliant tier used by over 1 million providers. TheraNest is a comprehensive mental health EHR that includes telehealth as one of many features alongside scheduling, billing, documentation, and client portal. The question is whether you need just telehealth or full practice management.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Doxy.me's free tier includes unlimited 1:1 video calls with HIPAA compliance—hard to beat for telehealth-only needs. Paid plans ($35-65/month) add group calls, custom branding, and HD video. TheraNest costs $29-89/therapist/month and includes telehealth plus full practice management. If you only need telehealth, Doxy.me free is cheapest. If you need scheduling, billing, and notes, TheraNest's price includes everything.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Doxy.me provides: browser-based video visits, virtual waiting room, HIPAA compliance (free), custom waiting room (paid), group sessions (paid), and screen sharing. TheraNest provides: telehealth, appointment scheduling with client self-booking, insurance billing and claims, progress notes and treatment plans, client portal, and practice reports. Doxy.me excels at one thing; TheraNest is a complete practice solution.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on what you need beyond video visits:

recommendations.when: You only need telehealth, want a free HIPAA-compliant option, or already have a separate EHR for practice management and just need to add video visits
You need complete practice management (scheduling, billing, documentation) and want telehealth included—no need for a separate telehealth tool
Rarely necessary—TheraNest includes telehealth. But if TheraNest's video quality doesn't meet your needs, some practices add Doxy.me for video while using TheraNest for everything else

faqs.q: Is Doxy.me really free and HIPAA-compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Doxy.me's free tier includes HIPAA compliance with a signed BAA. It offers unlimited 1:1 video sessions. Paid features (group calls, HD, branding) require subscription, but basic telehealth is genuinely free.

TheraNest includes integrated telehealth that works for most practices. It's convenient because it's built into scheduling and documentation. Some practices prefer dedicated telehealth tools like Doxy.me for video quality, but TheraNest's telehealth is functional.

faqs.q: Can I use Doxy.me with TheraNest?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use Doxy.me for video visits while using TheraNest for practice management. However, this means managing two systems. Most practices find TheraNest's built-in telehealth sufficient and prefer one integrated platform.

faqs.q: Which is better for a new therapy practice?
faqs.a: TheraNest if you need full practice management (most practices do). Doxy.me free if you're just starting, only doing telehealth, and handling scheduling/billing manually or with other tools.
